admin.overlay_help: A dark layer over covers, so names and stats stay legible on bright images.
admin.on_directory: Show covers in the member directory
admin.on_directory_help: For forums running FoF User Directory.
admin.use_fof_upload: Store member uploads with FoF Upload
admin.use_fof_upload_help: When FoF Upload is enabled, a member's cover goes through it like their other images: its storage, resizing, watermark and WebP thumbnails, and it appears in their My Media. Members FoF Upload does not let upload images, and forums without it, use Backdrop's own storage.
admin.max_size_help: Covers are resized to 1920px wide when they are stored, so a large photo still loads quickly.
admin.default_help: Shown for members who have not set a cover. Saved as soon as you change it.
admin.permission_choose: Choose a profile cover from the gallery
admin.gallery_help: Covers members can choose from, in this order. Drag to reorder. Up to {max}.
admin.gallery_empty: No covers yet. Members can only upload their own until you add some.
admin.gallery_delete_confirm: Delete this cover? Members using it will go back to the default cover.
